item.title: Ontario driver faces impairment charges, fell asleep in middle of highway 403
item.description: A 23-year-old Kitchener man has been charged with impaired driving after police found him asleep behind the wheel in the middle lane of Highway 403 in Hamilton late Thursday.

item.title: Quebec police set up post in Mont-Tremblant, one year after man’s disappearance
item.description: One year after 22-year-old Liam Toman disappeared from a Mont-Tremblant ski resort, Quebec police and his family are asking anyone with information to come forward.

item.title: Ice and art: Winnipeg’s frozen river trail
item.description: Perhaps one of the best embodiments of Canadians' ability to embrace winter, rather than hide from it, pops up every December at the confluence of the Red and Assiniboine rivers.

item.title: Evacuation orders lifted in B.C.’s Comox Valley after flooding
item.description: Evacuation alerts were cancelled and all evacuation orders rescinded in B.C.’s Comox Valley after flooding conditions improved and safety assessments were completed.

item.title: Man charged in ‘unprovoked’ Mississauga attacks that left 58-year-old woman dead
item.description: A 58-year-old man has been charged with second-degree murder and assault in two random Mississauga attacks Friday evening, Peel Police said.

item.title: Calgary widow turns grief into community ahead of Valentine’s Day
item.description: Six weeks before her wedding, Hannah Carnat-Gronnerud lost her fiancé in a sudden accident and is now transforming grief into connection for widows.

item.title: Faith through initiative: Saskatchewan Muslim students give back to the homeless
item.description: Participating students say giving back to the community is a way they can practice their faith and they hope to inspire other communities.

item.title: Saskatchewan Roughriders face off in 2026 Winter Classic
item.description: The Saskatchewan Roughriders traded turf for ice in their 2026 Winter Classic game that had fans cheering loud with the Grey Cup in the building.

item.title: Leafs snap six-game skid with win over Canucks
item.description: Auston Matthews and William Nylander, returning from injury, scored in a shootout as the Toronto Maple Leafs defeated the Vancouver Canucks 3-2 Saturday in a battle between two struggling Canadian teams.

item.title: Hughes stays hot, Wild trounce Oilers 7-3
item.description: Quinn Hughes scored, contributed an assist and made franchise history Saturday night as his Minnesota Wild thumped the Edmonton Oilers 7-3.
